items.prompt: Wide shot of a contemporary dance performance inside Dansens Hus Stockholm, two dancers mid-leap across a dimly lit stage bathed in cool blue wash, hardwood floor reflecting overhead spots, audience silhouettes in the foreground under warm house light.

Medium shot of a dancer in a flowing pale dress extending one arm toward a partner crouched on the scuffed wooden floor of Dansens Hus, single warm side-light carving their figures against deep shadow, sweat visible on bare shoulder.

Empty stage at MDT Moderna Dansteatern between rehearsals, black marley floor scuffed from footwork, a single folding chair and discarded water bottle, afternoon daylight filtering through tall industrial windows of the Stockholm venue, dust suspended in the air.

Close-up of a dancer's pointe shoes laced tightly over reddened ankles, ribbons trailing across the painted black stage floor of a Stockholm theater, shallow depth of field blurring a row of warm footlights in the background.

Intimate angle from the front row of a small Dansens Hus studio showing two dancers in slow contact improvisation, foreheads almost touching, breathing visible in cool stage haze, single spotlight from above isolating their torsos against black curtains.
